# Alpha Surge

> Alpha Surge is a Men's Vitality Supplement. Alpha Surge is a men's vitality supplement formulated around three well-known ingredients: Tongkat Ali, Ashwagandha and L-Arginine. Taken as part of a daily routine, it is designed to support stamina, healthy circulation and a calmer response to everyday stress — the trio of concerns many men notice creeping up as work, family and training demands pile on. It is a capsule-based daily supplement rather than a stimulant or a quick fix, and it fits into an ordinary morning routine without complicating it.
